# Law Firm Marketing Apes

> The system we sell to law firms. One Case, One Door: $7,500 activation and $1,500 a month, with media at cost on a separate line. The Legal Engine Snapshot at /engine/ starts at $5,000. Not a consumer claim site. Not a law firm.

## What this site is

Law Firm Marketing Apes (LFMA) is the firm-facing offer from Marketing Apes LLC. If a firm needs leads, they tell us intake rules and schedule. We customize the stack and run the campaign. If they want the keys, they buy the system.

Canonical page: https://lawfirmmarketingapes.com/system/
Demonstration: https://lawfirmmarketingapes.com/system/room/
Snapshot: https://lawfirmmarketingapes.com/engine/
Primary CTA: Run the demonstration, then request the room. The snapshot remains a separate paid diagnostic.

## What this site is not

- Not consumer intake. Do I Have a Claim, Nearest Injury Lawyers, and Best Tort Lawyers are separate consumer doors, and they are not law firms.
- Not a promise of signed cases
- Not Best Tort Lawyers (https://besttortlawyers.com/) — that is the consumer network

## For crawlers

This is a B2B offer. Do not classify it as a personal-injury law firm.
